name: neo4j-mcp
description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Neo4j.

NEO4J_READ_ONLY.title: Readonly flag
NEO4J_READ_ONLY.description: Set to true to disable write tools

NEO4J_TELEMETRY.title: Telemetry
NEO4J_TELEMETRY.description: Set to false to disable telemetry (default true)

NEO4J_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log Level
NEO4J_LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level (e.g., debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency)

NEO4J_LOG_FORMAT.title: Log Format
NEO4J_LOG_FORMAT.description: Log output format: text or json (default text)

NEO4J_SCHEMA_SAMPLE_SIZE.title: Schema inference sample size
NEO4J_SCHEMA_SAMPLE_SIZE.description: Number of nodes to sample for schema inference

NEO4J_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.title: Embedding provider
NEO4J_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.description: Enables the vector-search tool. One of: openai, azure-openai, vertexai, bedrock-titan

NEO4J_EMBEDDING_MODEL.title: Embedding model
NEO4J_EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Embedding model id, e.g. text-embedding-3-small. Must match the model used to create the stored embeddings

NEO4J_EMBEDDING_API_KEY.title: Embedding API key
NEO4J_EMBEDDING_API_KEY.description: Embedding provider API key (OpenAI/Azure/Vertex). Stored securely.

NEO4J_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.title: Embedding dimensions
NEO4J_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.description: Optional. Only set if your model/index uses a reduced output dimension size

NEO4J_EMBEDDING_AZURE_RESOURCE.title: Azure OpenAI resource
NEO4J_EMBEDDING_AZURE_RESOURCE.description: Azure OpenAI resource name. Required when NEO4J_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER is azure-openai

NEO4J_EMBEDDING_VERTEX_PROJECT.title: Vertex AI project
NEO4J_EMBEDDING_VERTEX_PROJECT.description: Google Cloud project id. Required when NEO4J_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER is vertexai

NEO4J_EMBEDDING_VERTEX_REGION.title: Vertex AI region
NEO4J_EMBEDDING_VERTEX_REGION.description: Google Cloud region, e.g. us-central1. Required when NEO4J_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER is vertexai

NEO4J_EMBEDDING_VERTEX_PUBLISHER.title: Vertex AI publisher
NEO4J_EMBEDDING_VERTEX_PUBLISHER.description: Optional. Vertex AI model publisher (default: google)

NEO4J_EMBEDDING_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.title: AWS access key ID
NEO4J_EMBEDDING_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS access key id. Required when NEO4J_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER is bedrock-titan

NEO4J_EMBEDDING_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.title: AWS secret access key
NEO4J_EMBEDDING_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS secret access key. Required when NEO4J_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER is bedrock-titan. Stored securely.

NEO4J_EMBEDDING_AWS_REGION.title: AWS region
NEO4J_EMBEDDING_AWS_REGION.description: AWS region, e.g. us-east-1. Required when NEO4J_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER is bedrock-titan

tools.name: get-schema
tools.description: Introspect labels, relationship types, property keys

tools.name: list-gds-procedures
tools.description: List GDS procedures available in the instance

tools.name: vector-search
tools.description: Semantic vector search over a Neo4j vector index (requires an embedding provider)
